$description: The chart parts (platform/charts/parts: Axis, GridLines, ChartLegend, ChartTooltip, DataLabel, ReferenceLine, ChartAnnotation; library wave 8, lane A): their component tokens. Series and thresholds take their colors from the data-viz scales (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role. Grid lines use the frame's chart-grid-line tokens.

chart-axis-tick-offset.$description: Axis: the distance from the plot's edge to a tick label.

chart-axis-label-text.$description: Axis: the axis title (what is measured), secondary text.

chart-axis-label-font-family.$description: Axis: the axis title's typeface (UI text: a name, not a value).

chart-axis-label-font-size.$description: Axis: the axis title's size (the tick labels' size).

chart-axis-label-font-weight.$description: Axis: the axis title's weight, a step above the tick labels.

chart-body-gap.$description: Chart frame with a legend beside the plot (legendPosition end): the space between the plot and the legend.

chart-legend-end-max-width.$description: Chart legend beside the plot: its widest; longer names wrap.

chart-legend-column-gap.$description: Chart legend: the space between series in a row.

chart-legend-row-gap.$description: Chart legend: the space between lines of series.

chart-legend-item-gap.$description: Chart legend: the space between a swatch, its name and its value.

chart-legend-label-font-family.$description: Chart legend: the names' typeface (UI text).

chart-legend-label-line-height.$description: Chart legend: the names' line height.

chart-legend-value-text.$description: Chart legend: a series' value after its name (secondary text). content-muted (2026-10-19): the same gray as subtle in light, the readable light gray in dark (subtle read 3.05:1 on a dark card).

chart-legend-value-font-family.$description: Chart legend: values are technical: the data font (Reddit Mono).

chart-legend-swatch-size.$description: Chart legend: the square swatch's side.

chart-legend-swatch-radius.$description: Chart legend: the square swatch's corners.

chart-legend-swatch-border-width.$description: Chart legend: the swatch's outline in the series color (what stays of a hidden series' swatch).

chart-legend-line-swatch-width.$description: Chart legend: the line swatch's length (line series).

chart-legend-line-swatch-height.$description: Chart legend: the line swatch's thickness, the line series' stroke.

chart-legend-toggle-min-height.$description: Interactive chart legend: a toggle's smallest height, the pointer target.

chart-legend-toggle-padding-inline.$description: Interactive chart legend: the space inside a toggle at its start and end.

chart-legend-toggle-radius.$description: Interactive chart legend: a toggle's corners.

chart-legend-toggle-border-width.$description: Interactive chart legend: a toggle's border, transparent until it has keyboard focus.

chart-legend-toggle-hover-background.$description: Interactive chart legend: a toggle under the pointer.

chart-legend-toggle-focus-border-color.$description: Interactive chart legend: a focused toggle's border (focus changes only the border color).

chart-legend-off-text.$description: Interactive chart legend: the name of a hidden series (muted; its swatch is hollow).

chart-legend-off-line-color.$description: Interactive chart legend: the line swatch of a hidden line series (a line has no outline to keep, so it turns to the disabled color).

chart-tooltip-offset.$description: Chart tooltip: the distance from the point (or the crosshair) to the tooltip.

chart-tooltip-background.$description: Chart tooltip: the surface (the overlay surface, as Popover).

chart-tooltip-radius.$description: Chart tooltip: the corners (the menu radius).

chart-tooltip-shadow.$description: Chart tooltip: the shadow (the menu elevation).

chart-tooltip-padding-block.$description: Chart tooltip: the space inside the border, top and bottom.

chart-tooltip-padding-inline.$description: Chart tooltip: the space inside the border, start and end.

chart-tooltip-gap.$description: Chart tooltip: the space between the title and the values.

chart-tooltip-list-gap.$description: Chart tooltip: the space between values.

chart-tooltip-item-gap.$description: Chart tooltip: the space between a swatch and its series' name.

chart-tooltip-font-family.$description: Chart tooltip: the typeface of the title and the names (UI text).

chart-tooltip-title-text.$description: Chart tooltip: the title (the point's category or date).

chart-tooltip-label-text.$description: Chart tooltip: a series' name (secondary text).

chart-tooltip-value-font-family.$description: Chart tooltip: values and data titles (dates, numbers) are technical: the data font (Reddit Mono).

chart-tooltip-value-margin-inline-start.$description: Chart tooltip: the least space between a name and its value.

chart-tooltip-swatch-size.$description: Chart tooltip: the swatch's side (the legend's swatch).

chart-tooltip-crosshair-color.$description: Shared chart tooltip: the crosshair line down the plot at the point's x.

chart-tooltip-crosshair-width.$description: Shared chart tooltip: the crosshair line's width.

chart-data-label-text.$description: Data label: the value written beside its mark.

chart-data-label-font-family.$description: Data label: values are technical: the data font (Reddit Mono).

chart-data-label-font-size.$description: Data label: the size (the tick labels' size).

chart-data-label-offset.$description: Data label: the distance from its mark (top, end).

chart-data-label-halo-color.$description: Data label centered on a mark: the halo around the text, in the surface color.

chart-data-label-halo-width.$description: Data label centered on a mark: the halo's width.

chart-reference-line-color.$description: Reference line: the line (a target, an average).

chart-reference-line-dash.$description: Reference line and threshold: the dash, which tells them from a series (solid).

chart-reference-line-gap.$description: Reference line and threshold: the gap between dashes.

chart-threshold-line-width.$description: Threshold: the line's width, a step above a reference line (its color is the alert scale's).

chart-reference-label-font-family.$description: Reference line: its name's typeface (UI text).

chart-reference-label-offset.$description: Reference line: the distance from the line to its label.

chart-reference-label-halo-color.$description: Reference line: the halo around its label in the surface color, so it stays readable over a mark.

chart-reference-label-halo-width.$description: Reference line: the label halo's width.

chart-reference-value-text.$description: Reference line: its value after the name (secondary text).

chart-reference-value-font-family.$description: Reference line: the value is technical: the data font (Reddit Mono).

chart-annotation-ring-color.$description: Annotation: the ring around the annotated point.

chart-annotation-leader-color.$description: Annotation: the leader line from the ring to the note.

chart-annotation-band-background.$description: Range annotation: the shaded span behind the marks (the sunken surface).

chart-annotation-label-halo-color.$description: Annotation: the halo around the note in the surface color, so it stays readable over a line or a mark.

chart-annotation-label-offset.$description: Annotation: the distance from the leader's end (or the range's corner) to the note.
